facts.fact: The Central Bank of Eswatini's Deputy Head of IT says the Eswatini Payment Switch, part of the bank's strategy to modernise the national payment system, has run stably under regulatory oversight since going live on 11 December 2024.

SWZ.note: Document states nothing on consumer rules or redress.
Only plans to extend the switch to public-sector services; no G2P payment stated.

facts.fact: The Eswatini Payment Switch allows instant transfers between banks and mobile money providers, with eight institutions connected including E-mali, MTN MoMo and InstaCash, per the Central Bank of Eswatini.
The Central Bank of Eswatini says the national Eswatini Payment Switch, live since 11 December 2024, connects banks and mobile wallets and processed 194,000 transactions worth E856 million.

SWZ.note: Document does not mention tax or fee payment.
